description: This file defines an abstract class `MaterialsProviderV2` which implements part of the AWS SDK for PHP related to cryptographic materials provisioning. It includes static methods for supported key sizes and generates IVs, as well as abstract methods for key wrapping and unwrapping and key generation.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: An abstract base class defining cryptographic material provider interface with methods for key size support, IV generation, and abstract methods for key wrapping/unwrapping and generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size in bits is supported (128 or 256).

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the wrapping algorithm name.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt an encrypted content encryption key (CEK).

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a new content encryption key.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) using OpenSSL for a specified cipher.
